Primarina is a solid choice against dragons, and Garchomp could work well against Steelix and Poison types. Gholdengo might effectively counter Toxapex and Gengar. If I lead with Garchomp, I might need to switch to Primarina if Rotom comes out. A lineup of Garchomp, Primarina, and Gholdengo feels right.
